minimal_documentation_text: The upstream-adapted active-group candidate (semantic 3, candidate 8) passed 819/819 interleaved-v1 paired cases on one RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition (188 SMs): 373 prefill/446 decode, 216 confirmations, 1,251 phases and 221,940 raw latency samples. The sanitized case-level export provides all raw samples, pre/post correctness checkpoints, block order and phase medians. b12x at measurement used base a489f972 plus dirty and declared untracked inputs; the harness root was also dirty, so no exact public commit identifies the measured source. The recorded source identity is not immutable proof. The earlier sequential baseline and failures 599/617 remain separate historical evidence; no SM121 or whole-upstream-suite qualification is claimed.

import formal_prefill_slice as prefill,formal_decode_slice as decode
manifest=[dict(mode=mode,index=i,ids=[c.id for c in module.cases(i)]) for mode,module,count in [('prefill',prefill,47),('decode',decode,56)] for i in range(count)]

 dst=out/('prefill-'+str(index).zfill(2));dst.mkdir()
 with (dst/'run.log').open('w') as f:
  rc=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'validation/megajob/wi004_route_tp_20260922/formal_prefill_slice.py',str(dst),str(index)],stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
 results.append(dict(mode='prefill',index=index,exit_status=rc));(out/'progress.json').write_text(json.dumps(results));print(results[-1],flush=True)
 if rc:sys.exit(rc)
